admission.justification: Spans knowledge_writer/deferrals.py, tasks/task_facts.py, and knowledge_writer/authoring.py, and is guarded by ten targeted writer tests, including three crossing-sync tests.

applicability: Every dependent record write through knowledge_write or knowledge-ingest on converted memory.
conditions: Condition task IDs are checked against live and archived canonical task documents via load_task_facts, refusing unknown, master, or terminal tasks.
Re-deferral requires a changed task or file condition or a moved candidate fileBlob on the same file, refusing note-only re-deferrals.
Any write that lifts a deferral must record a deferral_lifted history row and cannot combine lift with confirmation.

For non-crossing owners (leaf, wave), confirming a dependent (new or existing) with open deferrals is refused unless the leaf edited the document, naming every open deferral's ID, owner, passage, and reason.

For crossing writes (gated on owner.kind == 'crossing', used for crossing syncs at code_base == snapshot.commit), the writer skips leaf-only unedited-confirmation refusals, preserves before['deferrals'] when 'deferrals' is omitted, clears deferrals on [] or null, and otherwise requires a list of DependentDeferral entries with unique IDs, accepting task-only deferrals and requiring condition.file, when present, to exist in settled authoring.code.blobs while accepting earlier fileBlob values.
exclusions: Direct authoring of the raw deferrals list outside a crossing sync resolution.
Post-sync unedited confirmations introduced by a merge, which are caught by the closeout gate.
statement: knowledge_write executes defer, redefer (allowing same-file re-defer with the new blob when due by changed fileBlob and refusing note-only re-deferrals), lift (requiring a deferral_lifted history row so MQC surfaces every lift), and partial resolveDeferrals on confirmations, refuses invalid task/file/passage/reason inputs against coordination task documents, refuses non-crossing confirmations of any unedited dependent document (new or existing) with open deferrals while naming every open deferral, and for crossing writes (gated on owner.kind == 'crossing', used for crossing syncs at code_base == snapshot.commit) skips the leaf-only unedited-confirmation refusals, preserves before['deferrals'] when omitted, clears deferrals on empty list or null, and validates and adopts explicit merged deferrals.
title: knowledge_write validates deferrals, crossing syncs, and unedited confirmations
